A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 21-page GSDP paper, including Appendices A–E. Pages 2–21 match in extracted text and rendered appearance; the small first-page edits are fully comparable.

before.justification: v1 reports original GSDP model evaluations, pre-training experiments, component ablations, joint-scoring experiments, and appendix analyses of synthetic data.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 1–6, the Figure 4 ablations, and the appendix similarity and diversity analyses.

M1.justification: The four-stage GSDP pipeline, dual filtering, knowledge-point graph combinations, problem/solution generation, and multi-model evaluation remain identical.

E1.justification: Both retain the same MATH seed data, GSDP-MATH training corpus, mathematical benchmarks, pre-training evaluations, and Appendix C scientific-reasoning tasks.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in every corresponding experiment. Table 1 retains both official and reproduced MathScale Mistral entries, and the other model and dataset comparisons also match.

E3.justification: The two-epoch fine-tuning setup, 3.5-billion-token pre-training budget, evaluation procedures, and 5,000-item joint-scoring test remain unchanged, as do appendix sampling and analysis settings.

E4.justification: Knowledge-point combination ablations (Figure 4), joint-scoring comparisons (Table 4), dual-filtering analysis (Appendix D), and seed-similarity/diversity analyses (Appendix E) are identical.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical throughout. Neither version supplies repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical results and plotted findings match. For example, Table 1 retains GSDP-7B accuracy of 37.7% on MATH and 78.4% on GSM8K; appendix results are also unchanged.

T1.justification: The graph and edge definitions in Section 2.3 and synthesis-cost calculations in Appendix B are unchanged. No assumptions, proofs, or mathematical reasoning are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about scalable, low-cost graph-based synthesis, GSDP-MATH, data quality, and improved reasoning performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning implicit relationships, data diversity, generalization, and the scoring precision/retention tradeoff are unchanged. No substantive limitations or applicability qualifications are added.

D1.justification: The abstract replaces an unspecified future dataset/model availability statement with a planned release at the Jayce1kk/GSDP GitHub repository. This adds a concrete release location; the PDFs do not establish that release has occurred.

R1.justification: Section 4, the bibliography, and the positioning relative to earlier synthesis methods are identical. No cited research is added or removed.

P1.justification: Only the abstract's final availability sentence and the arXiv version/date stamp change. The remaining prose, terminology, section organization, and appendices are unchanged.

P2.justification: The added repository address slightly reflows the first-page abstract. Figures 1–8, Tables 1–6, and the rendered layouts of pages 2–21 are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 provides a specific location for the promised dataset and model release, modestly improving the usefulness of its access information. Scientific content and evidence remain unchanged, and the future-tense statement does not establish actual resource availability.
